title: Abdul Khader v. State of Kerala

content.caseIdentity: Abdul Khader v. State of Kerala, 2024 SCC OnLine Ker 3892
content.facts: The petitioner was convicted by the Sessions Court in a trial held under the CrPC 1973. The judgment of conviction was pronounced on 28 June 2024. The petitioner filed an appeal before the High Court on 5 July 2024, styling it under Section 374 CrPC. The registry objected that the appeal must be filed under Section 528 BNSS.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether an appeal filed on or after 1 July 2024 challenging a conviction passed in a trial conducted under the 1973 CrPC should be filed under Section 374 CrPC or Section 528 BNSS.
content.ratioDecidendi: Applying Section 531(2)(a) BNSS and Garikapati Veeraya, the trial was pending immediately before 1 July 2024, and the right of appeal had already crystallized. The appeal is substantively governed by Section 374 CrPC. The registry was directed to number and entertain the appeal under the CrPC.
content.holding: Appeals arising from trials that were pending or concluded prior to 1 July 2024 are maintainable and saved under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
content.relevance: Contemporary post-2024 judicial precedent resolving the exact appellate conflict under Section 531(2)(a) BNSS.
